# SAM Intelligence Group

> Global AI Engineering, MLOps, Data Pipeline, and Full-Stack Software House founded by Syed Abdullah Bin Masood.

SAM Intelligence Group (`https://samintelligencegroup.com`) designs, builds, and deploys production data engineering pipelines, reproducible MLOps systems, custom web and .NET software platforms, and human-reviewed applied AI workflows for clients worldwide.

## Core Services
- [Data Engineering & ETL](https://samintelligencegroup.com/#services): Ingestion, validation, ETL/ELT transformation workflows, governed cloud/SQL storage (BigQuery, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SSIS), and reporting-ready analytical foundations.
- [MLOps & Production AI](https://samintelligencegroup.com/#services): Leakage-safe feature preparation, chronological evaluation, MLflow experiment tracking and model registry, FastAPI model serving, monitoring, and automated retraining loops.
- [Full-Stack Web & Product Engineering](https://samintelligencegroup.com/#services): Responsive React and ASP.NET Core MVC web applications, FastAPI and .NET 10 backends, EF Core data layers, and C#/WPF desktop operator suites.
- [Custom AI Solutions](https://samintelligencegroup.com/#services): Multimodal computer vision (PyTorch, OpenCV, YOLO, MediaPipe), local-first LLM agents (Ollama, LangChain), research synthesis pipelines, and explicit human-review interfaces.

## Global Industries Served
- [Industries & Solutions Directory](https://samintelligencegroup.com/industries): Custom systems for Pharmacies & Healthcare Retail, Retail & E-commerce, B2B Wholesale & Distribution, Manufacturing & Industrial Operations, Logistics & Supply Chain, Media, Research & Publishing, and Environmental Data & Smart Infrastructure.

## Verified Case Studies
- [Case Studies Overview](https://samintelligencegroup.com/case-studies): Deep-dive architectural walkthroughs and verified implementation outcomes.
- [Three-City AQI Forecasting Platform](https://samintelligencegroup.com/case-studies/aqi-forecasting): End-to-end MLOps system processing 105,054 checked-in hourly rows across Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad with a 606-feature contract, chronological evaluation (Ridge, Random Forest, Histogram Gradient Boosting), MLflow registry, FastAPI serving, Streamlit dashboard, and GitHub Actions automation.
- [Lobatse Pharmacy Platform](https://samintelligencegroup.com/case-studies/lobatse-pharmacy): Custom .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core MVC / EF Core pharmacy e-commerce and operations platform on AWS (EC2, RDS PostgreSQL, S3), connecting customer shopping, stock-aware baskets, COD checkout, and separate authorized pharmacist prescription review across 11,204 processed source catalog rows.
- [DeepGuard Multimodal Forensics](https://samintelligencegroup.com/projects?project=deepguard): Multi-branch deepfake video detection architecture combining visual, motion, physics-informed, forensic, and audio branches (186 commits, PyTorch, OpenCV, Docker).
- [SAM-EDA Open-Source Python Package](https://pypi.org/project/sam_eda/): Published PyPI library automating heuristic exploratory data analysis and dataset diagnostics.
